title: The check-tail guard reads `&` inside expansions and arithmetic correctly
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 16:00 CST Nov 8, from round-3 or later reviews; queued follow-up the lane starts when its wait ends. Waits on #2156. Allowed where main refuses: `echo ${x:-$(npm start & )}` and `i { &`. False alarms: `for((i=0;i&1;i++))`, `while((i&1))`, `echo $[5&3]`. Allowed on base too: `echo a & ci-job x | tail -3 & echo $!` and `ci-job x | tail -3 &&`+newline+`echo done & echo $!`.
note: Folded finding (#1717 round 3, sonnet, via lane bg-tail-loses-verdict 22:30 CST Nov 8): `check_tail_hit` reads no `$( )` or backtick text, so `x=$(merge --lane-lint 7 2>&1 | tail -3)` passes on main and head. Main has `substitution_commands` (hooks/guard_env.py) to reuse. Debt note check-tail-no-nested-read lists only bash -c and `{ }`; extend it. From #2015 (check-tail-any-filter, round 3 passed, net value positive; lane bg-tail-loses-verdict 22:32 CST Nov 8): (1) stale notes in docs/debts/notes.md say `Select-Object -Last` and a trailing `& echo $!` pass; both are now refused, and the decision's Known gaps lists three notes, not five. (2) Rare false alarm in hooks/guard_stream.py: `ci-job checks --lint & echo $! | cat` is refused, since the `&` stays in the stage and `cat` reads as a filter. (3) No named mutant covers the `|&` skip in `_ends_in_ampersand`; the allowed row `ci-job checks --lint |& tail -3` has not been shown red. From #2156 (check-tail-glued-amp, round 3 at 7e81f6038 PASS, reviewer sonnet, net value positive; 22:37 CST Nov 8): (1) hooks/guard_core.py `_bash_arithmetic_spans` is quadratic when a `$((` is never closed and an `&` is present (2000 openers 0.77 s, 8000 openers 12.9 s). (2) `_amp_cuts` reads the legacy `$[1&2]` as a background job, a false refusal. (3) A bare `&` in a URL (`curl https://x/v1?a=1&b=2`) is now denied, correctly, but the remedy points to run_in_background or `echo $!`, not to quoting the URL.
